champion.tips: MORGANA TIPS AND TRICKS Morgana is good at setting up picks around objectives thanks to her Q . Place vision around the map and wait for an immobile enemy to walk past before engaging on them. To avoid wasting your Binding Q , look to engage after the enemy has used their dash or escape ability. If they’re holding on to it, walk up to them and bait it out. Aim your W so it covers as many minions as possible so you can push the wave quickly. When your W is doing work, run backwards so the enemy cannot poke or trade with you.
champion.builds: THE BEST MORGANA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Morgana Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Cheap Shot and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blackfire Torch as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Liandry's Torment. For your last 3 items, you should build Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap and finish with Cryptbloom. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 54.5% winrate over 9 239 matches played. Optional Your second option for Morgana Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Liandry's Torment, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Zhonya's Hourglass as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Horizon Focus, Cryptbloom and Rylai's Crystal Scepter. The skill order for this build is W - Q - E. In the current patch, this build has a 51.9% win rate over 905 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Luden's Companion as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Liandry's Torment as a third item. You want to finish the build with Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap and Horizon Focus. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 51.6% win rate across 858 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Morgana Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Arcane Comet, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch as your primary rune tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Zhonya's Hourglass as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Liandry's Torment as third item. The last 3 options are Rabadon's Deathcap, Horizon Focus and Cryptbloom. The ability order for this build is W - Q - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.5% win rate over 109 matches played. Situational Morgana Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Morgana build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Morgana runes page.
